session_summary: As the Economy Optimizer, I reviewed the play trace on Treasure Run where the player collected 5 coins, earned 25 upon completion, and subsequently purchased the Trail Cap (45 coins) and Moon Hood (80 coins), leaving 21 coins and falling short of the Waypoint Crown. Coin inflow and marketplace item pricing create a sharp tier gap that requires thoughtful mid-game saving decisions.

observations.evidence: Completing the Treasure Run yielded 25 coins plus 5 found on the route, totaling 30 coins earned, but marketplace cosmetics cost 45, 80, and more, leaving the player with only 21 coins after two purchases and unable to buy a premium item like the Waypoint Crown.
observations.recommendation: Monitor coin pacing across difficulty level 2 routes to ensure single-run completions feel closer to mid-tier cosmetic affordability without devaluing long-term progression goals.

feature_requests.title: Adjusted Marketplace Bundle Special for Mid-Tier Cosmetics
feature_requests.player_value: Helps bridge the currency gap for players saving toward elite crown items by offering a temporary thematic bundle discount.
feature_requests.rationale: The coin delta between standard route completion rewards and high-end items like the Waypoint Crown leaves players stranded with low balances (21 coins remaining in trace), making a promotional discount or milestone coin bonus very effective for retention.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce a rotating weekend marketplace special or bundle discount to maintain purchasing momentum for active economy players.

keep: Clear feedback messages upon successful and failed marketplace transactions (e.g., 'Not enough coins.').
Satisfying reward pacing where completing a route provides a solid lump-sum injection of coins.
Meaningful spending choices that force players to prioritize lower-cost cosmetics before saving for elite items.
focus: coin flow, marketplace value, reward pacing, meaningful spending decisions
